review.tagline: Agent skill that draws brand-styled diagrams as single HTML and SVG files
review.summary: An Agent Skill that has a coding agent write one self-contained HTML file with inline SVG for a requested diagram. It covers 45 diagram types, each in minimal light, minimal dark and full-editorial variants, and can pull a site's palette and fonts so later diagrams match. It also imports Mermaid, draw.io and Excalidraw files and exports to SVG or PNG.
review.audience: Developers who publish polished diagrams and already use a coding agent
strengths: Output is one HTML file with inline SVG; no build step, JavaScript or external images
45 diagram types, each in light, dark and editorial variants
Installs on many hosts: Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Cline, Pi, Kiro
CI checks for overlaps and clipping; layout is on a 4px grid
weaknesses: Output quality depends on the model; the same prompt can lay out differently twice
Not an editable source format: no text to diff, no canvas to drag boxes on
One opinionated editorial style; other looks need style guide edits
Slash commands (/export-diagram, /profile) only in native packages, not the skills CLI install
